_about: Round 3 of the evaluation set: the cases the original 97 queries cannot see.
Three strata, deliberately scored SEPARATELY -- they are different retrieval tasks and a
single mean over them would hide all three. See EVALUATION_AUDIT.md section 8.
entity   (11) alphanumeric biomedical identity, built as pairs the pre-audit tokeniser collapsed
code      (3) known-item retrieval by registry id; ground truth is objective string containment
negation  (8) four positive/negated pairs; the pair, not the query, is the measurement
Provenance: entity and negation judgements are model-generated under the round-2 protocol
(topic-area reading, threshold loosened; kappa 0.800 measured against human labels in round 2).
The code stratum needs no judgement at all and is the only judgement-free data in this project.
One query was written and dropped: 'MERS-CoV and SARS-CoV-1 comparison' has no relevant document
in a corpus of COVID-19 trials. It survives in scripts/round3_ablation.py as a discrimination probe.

queries.note: Trial evaluates an IL-6 or IL-6R directed agent (tocilizumab, sarilumab, siltuximab, anti-IL6), or is an IL-6-focused study of COVID hyperinflammation. Agents acting on other cytokines are not relevant however severe the inflammation.
Trial evaluates IL-1 pathway blockade (anakinra, canakinumab, IL-1Ra) or is an IL-1-focused study. IL-6 agents are the paired contrast and are not relevant.
Study measures or characterises T-cell (CD4-inclusive) responses in COVID. CD8-only studies are the paired contrast and are excluded; cell-therapy trials that do not measure response are excluded.
Study measures or characterises CD8 / cytotoxic T-cell responses, or T-cell responses inclusive of CD8. CD4-only studies excluded.

Study measures, induces or administers SARS-CoV-2-specific / neutralising antibodies: serology, antibody kinetics, monoclonals, convalescent plasma. Vaccine trials are excluded unless antibody measurement is the stated endpoint.
Trial of the Pfizer-BioNTech BNT162b2 / Comirnaty vaccine, including heterologous schedules and co-administration studies that involve it.
Trial of Moderna mRNA-1273 (including mRNA-1273.351 and mRNA-vaccine schedule studies) with immunogenicity endpoints.
Trial of ChAdOx1 nCoV-19 / AZD1222 / Vaxzevria / Covishield, including heterologous prime-boost studies that involve it.

Study concerns ACE2 itself: its expression, imaging, or recombinant/modulated form. ACE-inhibitor and ARB trials are excluded unless ACE2 is named as the object of study -- they are a different entity and including them would blur exactly the distinction this stratum tests.
Study measures D-dimer, or investigates thrombosis / thromboembolism / coagulopathy including its treatment. Generic biomarker panels that do not name D-dimer or a thrombotic outcome are excluded.
Trial administering or measuring vitamin D / D3 / 25-hydroxyvitamin D3, alone or in a combination arm. Other micronutrient trials (vitamin C, K2) are excluded.

Ground truth is exact string containment of the registry code in title+abstract. No judgement, model or human, is involved. None of these codes is a self-reference: each is cited by other trials, so this measures retrieval and not a row lookup.

POSITIVE CONTROL of a negation pair. Trial or study whose population is hospitalised COVID patients (ward or ICU). All-comer registries and outpatient studies excluded.

NEGATED TWIN. Population must be outpatient / ambulatory / community, or the endpoint must be preventing hospitalisation. A hospitalised-population trial is NOT relevant however similar its intervention -- that inversion is the whole point of the pair.
POSITIVE CONTROL. Study of patients receiving or requiring oxygen: oxygen therapy, HFNC, prone positioning for hypoxaemia, ventilatory support, hypoxaemic respiratory failure.

NEGATED TWIN. Population must be explicitly free of an oxygen requirement -- community/ambulatory, or a study that separates those who did not receive respiratory support. Oxygen-therapy and hypoxaemia trials are the contrast and are excluded.
POSITIVE CONTROL. Trial or study in severe / critical COVID pneumonia.
NEGATED TWIN. Population must be mild / moderate / non-severe, or the endpoint must be preventing progression to severe disease.
POSITIVE CONTROL. Study involving mechanical or non-invasive ventilation, ventilation management, respiratory support or ECMO.
NEGATED TWIN. Population must be non-intubated, or the aim must be to avoid ventilation; non-invasive support counts, invasive ventilation does not.
